incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A heavily damaged multi-story brick building with collapsed sections and debris piled on the street corner, with other buildings and traffic visible in the background.

observations.description: Large portion of a brick building is collapsed, exposing wooden framing and interior structure.
Street corner with traffic lights, street signs, and a lamppost, with debris including broken bricks and wood planks.
Cars are visible in the distance on the street.
A single orange traffic cone is visible near the debris pile.
A green tarp is lying on the ground near the debris.
